title: Decode Ways
statement:
A message is encoded by mapping 'A'=1, 'B'=2, ..., 'Z'=26.

Given a string of digits, count the number of ways to decode it.

Note: '0' cannot be decoded alone; it must be part of '10' or '20'. A string starting with '0' has 0 ways.
inputFormat: A single line containing the digit string.
outputFormat: A single integer: the number of ways to decode the string.

starterCode.python:
s = input().strip()
# Write your solution here
# Hint: dp[i] = ways to decode s[:i]
# dp[i] += dp[i-1] if s[i-1] != '0'
# dp[i] += dp[i-2] if 10 <= int(s[i-2:i]) <= 26
